name: shoot-2056
about: 2056 preloaded with 8 in its ALLIANCE ZONE in TELEOP: the turret swings round on its X44, the wheel's and backspin kicker's velocity loops and the hood come to the moving shot, the indexer (floor, belts, side kicker, Stealth feed) feeds, the intake retracts to push the last in; the FUEL go into the HUB; then it drives out past the zone line, intakes, and passes back at the hood's lowest angle (M3c).
